data.name: Rifaqat
data.gender_notes: Rifaqat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rifaqat signifies companionship and friendship. It is derived from the root 'rafaqa' which means to accompany, befriend or unite. The name Rifaqat carries the meaning “Companionship, Friendship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rifaqat usually hope their child will grow to embody companionship, friendship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Rifaqat refers to the group of close companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It symbolizes unity, mutual respect, and deep bonding among believers.
data.etymology: Rifaqat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companionship, Friendship.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rifaqat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رفاقت
in_arabic.meaning: رفاقت تعلق، موافق، دوستي، قربت، اور اخوت کا مطلب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رفاقت عربي زبان میں 'رفيق' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دوست، موافق، يا ساتھی۔ یہ نام اخوت، قربت، اور فہم و تفاهم کے خوبصورت احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقليد میں، رفاقت محبت، احترام، اور تعاون کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: رفاقت
in_urdu.meaning: رفاقت کا مطلب ہے تعلق، دوستی، قربت، اور موافقت
in_urdu.long_meaning: رفاقت نام عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، خاص طور پر 'رفيق' سے جو دوست یا ساتھی کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام دوستی، محبت، اور ایک دوسرے کے ساتھ قربت کے مضبوط بندھن پر زور دیتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، رفاقت ایک ایسا نام ہے جو ہم آہنگی اور اخوت کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रिफ़ाक़त
in_hindi.meaning: रिफ़ाक़त का अर्थ है संबंध, दोस्ती, और निकटता
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिफ़ाक़त नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, विशेष रूप से 'रफ़ीक' से जो मित्र या साथी के अर्थ में है। यह नाम मित्रता, प्रेम, और एक दूसरे के साथ निकटता के मजबूत बंधन पर बल देता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, रिफ़ाक़त एक ऐसा नाम है जो सहयोग और भाईचारे के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: رفاقت
in_pashto.meaning: رفاقت د ملګرتی، دوستی، او قربت معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رفاقت نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول 'رفيق' څخه چې د دوست يا ملګري معنی لري. دا نوم د دوستی، مینې، او د يو بل سره د قربت قوي اړيکې ټینګوي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو کې، رفاقت داسې يو نوم دی چې د همغږۍ او اخوت په اهمیت پوهاوی څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Rifaqat
in_english.meaning: Rifaqat means companionship, friendship, affection, closeness, and brotherhood
in_english.long_meaning: Rifaqat originates from the Arabic root 'rāfiq', meaning companion, friend, or associate. This name embodies the essence of friendship, love, and close relationship. In Islamic tradition, Rifaqat signifies harmony, respect, and cooperation. Historically, it has been used to express the importance of unity and brotherhood among Muslims. The name Rifaqat is associated with positive personality traits such as empathy, sociability, and warmth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rifaqat" holds a significant cultural impact as it reflects the importance of companionship and friendship in Islamic culture. In Islam, the bonds of brotherhood and sisterhood are considered sacred, and the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) emphasized the importance of treating friends with kindness, trust, and openness. The name is a reminder of the importance of building strong relationships and alliances in life, as it fosters a sense of community, trust, and support.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Rifaqat" lies in its reminder of the companionship and friendship that exists between human beings and their Creator. In Islamic teachings, Allah (swt) is described as the most compassionate and loving of companions, and believers are urged to seek His companionship in this life and in the hereafter. The name "Rifaqat" also represents the spiritual unity that exists between all beings, as we are all created by the same God and share the same ultimate destination - paradise. Ultimately, the name inspires us to strive towards building strong spiritual bonds with Allah and cultivating deep friendships with those around us.
